description: The face gallery and the state bindings. It draws; it reads the spec that is bundled beside it. It cannot reach the event stream, the approval queue, the connection settings or backend supervision — nothing in this window needs them, and it is the largest body of third-party-shaped drawing code in the app. It holds no event permission at all: in Tauri 2 a page's global listen() hears every event the app sends, even one sent to another window (event/listener.rs match_any_or_filter), so being able to listen would mean hearing the approval queue.
